errors.evidence: This is a summary and interpretation of the overall trend across multiple lines, which the prompt forbids. It is also an over-generalization, as some lines show significant peaks after 2014/2015 (e.g., the pink line in 2017).
The phrase 'Each of the graphs' is incorrect and confusing as there is only one graph in the figure.
The light orange line for 'УниКредит Булбанк' ends at a value clearly below 30% in 2027, closer to 25%. Describing it as 'около 30%' is inaccurate.
The dark blue line ('Пощенска банка') reaches its peak in 2012 at a value closer to 90%, not 80%. This is a significant understatement of the peak value.
The phrase 'significant fluctuations' is subjective and interpretive language, which should be avoided according to the prompt.
The second major peak for the light red/pink line ('ОББ вкл. СИБ') occurs in 2017, not 2016.
The grey line ('ПИБ') peaks in 2015 at a value of approximately 85%, not 90%. 'около 90%' is an overestimation.
